page_title: CRY 1-2 EVE | Crystal Palace v Everton 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90+4' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+3' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+2' Ashley Young (Everton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
86' Oliver Glasner has decided to make a change. Eddie Nketiah replaces Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace).
86' Oliver Glasner prepares a substitution. Will Hughes is replaced by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).
86' It is time for a substitution. Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) is on for Carlos Alcaraz.

86' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
84' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
83' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.

82' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
82' Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
80' 1 - 2 Goal! Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:2.
79' A substitution has been made. Jesper Lindstrom goes off and Ashley Young (Everton) comes on.
79' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement.
77' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
77' The total number of attempts is 13:9.
74' That's unlucky! Beto (Everton) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
73' The ball is cleared after Beto (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball has crossed the sideline. Everton are taking a throw-in.
70' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
67' What was James Garner (Everton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
67' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from James Garner (Everton).
66' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jesper Lindstrom (Everton).
66' Flag goes up against Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.

65' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace win a corner kick.

64' The ball is laid off to Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Jordan Pickford to make a decent save.
63' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) makes a strong challenge and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
63' Beto (Everton) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
60' The referee signals a substitution. Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace) is brought on as a substitute for Tyrick Mitchell.
60' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
58' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Beto (Everton) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Dean Henderson is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.

56' A clever short pass gives Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
55' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

54' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Good work from Crystal Palace as they win a corner.

54' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Dean Henderson pulls off a brilliant save.

53' A precise low pass is received by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
51' No offside! Referee Anthony Taylor points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Crystal Palace players.
48' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Crystal Palace goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

47' 1 - 1 Goal! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Marc Guehi assisted in the goal. 1:1.
46' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' Oliver Glasner makes a switch. Eberechi Eze is coming on in place of Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Jefferson Lerma is replaced by Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
45+2' James Garner (Everton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' 3:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

42' 0 - 1 GOAL! Carlos Alcaraz finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Beto (Everton), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 0:1.
42' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.
39' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is caught offside!
37' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
36' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

34' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
32' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
30' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

30' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Dean Henderson is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
28' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
25' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
21' The Crystal Palace players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Anthony Taylor signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to the ball going out of play.
21' Crystal Palace score a goal, but referee Anthony Taylor has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
20' The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner.
18' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
17' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
13' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is out of play. Everton will take a throw-in.
13' An attempted cross from Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is cleared.
12' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
11' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
10' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

8' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Jordan Pickford makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
7' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Jordan Pickford gets down to his right to keep it out.
6' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is adjudged offside.
5' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

3' Beto (Everton) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Everton will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will officiate today.
